title: Coronation
setup: Your pawn has marched all the way to **e7**, and the black king is standing right beside it.
hint: The black king attacks your pawn, and your own king is far away. Use this move before Black uses the next one.
explanation:
## The Idea

A pawn that reaches the last rank promotes: it turns, as part of the same move, into any piece you choose.

{{e8=Q}} turns a one-point pawn into a nine-point queen, and the king on f6 cannot reach e8 to take it. Any other move lets {{Kxe7}} remove the pawn, and the win is gone. With a queen against a bare king, checkmate follows.

A pawn one step from the end is worth promoting now.
